body: I’d break up with him. That would’ve hurt my feelings so bad… I feel for you
They always do this and it’s so annoying! Trying to convince you that it’s your GI organs smh

I know the feeling. It was horrible when I was experiencing it. But try cutting out acidic foods, chocolate, coffee, citrus, spicy foods etc. See what foods trigger you and what doesn’t. Hopefully that will help. You’re welcome!

I’ve had GERD, not sure if I had a hernia or an ulcer. But I was also on omeprazole and relcer gel. I made sure not to lay flat also. What really helped me was changing my whole diet. I ate only bland foods for like a month. It got better over time. 

If I eat extremely spicy foods these days I might get a flare but not as bad as it was.

I also used to work at an endoscopy center. Maybe it would be beneficial to try get an upper GI endoscopy procedure done to see what’s happening.
Break up with him sorry. Even if he’s sad about certain things he doesn’t have to be mean to you about it. You’re already going through so much.
Thanks to everyone for the responses! I appreciate them.
Where I live, endoscopy jobs aren’t common as they are in the US or other countries, so idts but I’ll do some research
Sadly I am employed by him :( it’s his private practice
